scope.document: 2014 Audi Q5/SQ5 Quick Reference Specification Book
scope.applicability_rule: Only the J840 battery-system configuration covered by this table; not every Q5/SQ5 powertrain and not all Audi vehicles.

sources.locator: Battery Regulation Control Module - J840; P0A1F row
sources.verification: PDF text and page image checked

records.monitoring_context_en: The J840 table associates this code with monitoring of contactor power, the latch and sustained-power signals, and watchdog operation. These conditions remain diagnostic context rather than additions to the code title.
records.monitoring_context_ar: يربط جدول J840 هذا الكود بمراقبة تغذية موصلات القدرة، وإشارات تثبيت التغذية واستمرارها، وعمل مؤقت المراقبة. هذه شروط رصد وليست أوصافاً فرعية تُضاف إلى اسم الكود.
records.source_variation_note: The same book uses a high-voltage battery-pack label for P0A1F on printed page 225. That separate table is not merged with the J840 definition; ECU/system context is required.
records.previous_scope_note: The earlier Ross-Tech Bentley-specific note remains preserved and is not used to establish Audi applicability.
records.subcode_policy: No numerical subcode or open/short/defective suffix invented.
records.closure_reason: The original Audi J840 table confirms that the component label itself is the complete displayed DTC title in this scope. Lack of a fault-mode suffix is not a missing translation.
